citations.text: The Unified Parkinson’s Disease Rating Scale (UPDRS) provides information about the severity of the disease and uses a point-scoring system ranging between 0 and 4 for each section.13 In our study, we used the sections assessing motor and daily life activities.
Statistical analysis was performed by the IBM SPSS Statistics for Windows version 17.0 (SPSS Inc, Chicago, IL, USA).
We selected a p-value of 0.05 for statistical significance.
We used the Wilcoxon Signed Rank Test for intragroup comparisons and the Mann-Whitney U test for inter-group comparisons.
